name: Air Partner plc
summary: Air Partner plc provides aircraft charter, aviation safety, and security solutions worldwide. It operates through four segments: Group Charter, Private Jets, Freight, and Safety & Security. The company provides group charter services for more than 20 passengers for governments, corporates, sports and entertainment teams, industrial, manufacturing customers, and tour operators; private jet charter services for up to 19 passengers for corporates and high net worth individuals; and charter and part-charter services of cargo aircraft for regular and bespoke requirements, including emergency aid drops, door-to-door freight delivery, and on-board couriers. It also offers specialist services, such as scheduled group travel, tour operations, air evacuation, aircraft sales and leasing, and flight operations; training, consulting, and managed services, which include fatigue risk management and auditing; security services; and wildlife hazard management and aircraft registry services. In addition, the company provides air traffic control (ATC) services, including ATC engineering; bird control services; and wildlife management units, as well as survival training for fast jet pilots. Further, it is involved in the remarketing, acquisition, and leasing of commercial aircraft and private jets; emergency planning comprising planning, executing, and managing air support and air evacuations activities; and travel services business. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Gatwick, the United Kingdom.
